usedFor: Aarven holds the bookkeeping for a Swiss business and HubSpot holds the sales side. Each “New Booking” in Aarven can open a “Create Deal” in HubSpot, so a booked entry shows up in the pipeline as something to follow.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Aarven, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A booking is the accounting record of money moving, and a deal gives sales a line to act on. “Create Deal” puts it into the pipeline with the values you map.

watchOut: “New Booking” in Aarven is polling: it finds the previous day's bookings and is checked once a day, so nothing lands in HubSpot the same day.
